caption: The drawing depicts a garment, likely a chasuble, with a rectangular shape, slightly rounded at the bottom, and a cutout at the top to accommodate the neck and shoulders. The central area of the garment features a large cross shape outlined in brown, filled with floral patterns. The flowers are primarily pink with green leaves and stems, and are arranged symmetrically within and around the cross. The background of the garment is white or cream-colored, providing a stark contrast to the floral designs. A brown border, slightly ornamented, runs around the entire perimeter of the garment. The flowers within the cross are larger and more detailed, with the central flower at the intersection of the cross being the largest and most prominent, colored in deeper reds and pinks with green leaves radiating outward. The lower section of the garment inside the brown border similarly features smaller pink flowers with green foliage. The drawing is on a plain, light background, and the only text present is in small letters at the bottom right, stating "Syrense Siveason."
title: Ecclesiastical Vestment
